Primary request: introduce a bounded repertoire of four native deciduous trees in four large2x2 illustrated specimen areas, with simple warm natural background, no tiny decorative details. Primary request: explain artificial selection from existing inherited variation in a simple supplied breeding model. A wide three-stage friendly plant garden illustration.
